description: The bar chart, titled "Accuracy (%)" and labeled "Token Count" on the secondary y-axis, compares the average performance and token usage of four different reasoning methods—CoT, CoD, CCoT, and CoUT—across four language models (LRMs) on four benchmarks. The primary y-axis, labeled "Accuracy (%)", ranges from 70 to 100, with the values of the bars shown above each respective bar. The x-axis displays the four methods, each represented by a distinct color: CoT (red), CoD (orange), CCoT (light blue), and CoUT (green). The secondary y-axis on the right, labeled "Token Count" and ranging from 0 to 800, indicates the number of tokens used, with values also displayed above the bars. The chart shows that CoT achieves the highest accuracy at 91.19%, followed by CCoT at 88.50%, CoD at 88.40%, and CoUT at 80.89%. In terms of token count, CoT uses the most tokens at 676.85, followed by CoD at 534.24, CCoT at 445.91, and CoUT at 354.46. The bars are sorted in descending order of accuracy on the left side and descending order of token count on the right side.
